meta.description: Manual depth-chart backstop for players who are unambiguous starters and therefore never trigger the injury-report/competition-language heuristic in build-projected-starters.js. Added because that heuristic only catches players mentioned in a competition/backup/injury context -- a true lock at the position generates no such chatter and silently drops out of the projected-starters snapshot otherwise.

players.evidence: Unquestioned RB1, workhorse role, no committee/competition -- verified by Andy 2026-09-15.
